### Loading required packages and scripts
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(ggplot2)
library(biomaRt)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
```
# Based on pseudobulk (expression)
```{r}
## Define variables and files
expr_cutoff <- 0.5
ref_pseudobulk <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Pseudobulks/MouseCompleteAtlas_AveragePseudobulk_ByCellType_26thMay2026.txt")
age_est <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/MolecularEvolutionAnalysis_July2026/age_of_transcriptome/Data/ReferenceFiles/MouseAtlas_AgeOfTranscriptomeInfo_PCG.txt")
pcg_list <- readRDS("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/GeneLists/PCGs/Mouse_GRCM39_PCG.rds")
pslg_reference <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/MolecularEvolutionAnalysis_July2026/positively_selected_genes_contribution/PositivelySelectedGenes/Data/ReferenceFiles/Mouse_AllGenesTested_ReferenceTable_r105.txt", header = T)
pslg_reference <- pslg_reference %>% na.omit()
psl_list <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/MolecularEvolutionAnalysis_July2026/positively_selected_genes_contribution/PositivelySelectedGenes/Data/ReferenceFiles/mouse_pos_sel_genes_list.tab", sep = "\t", header = F)
psl_list <- psl_list %>% dplyr::rename(ensembl_peptide_id = V1)

## Joining the lists
psl_list <- left_join(psl_list, pslg_reference) %>% pull(ensembl_gene_id)
psl_list <- psl_list %>% na.omit() %>% unique()
psl_list

## Obtaining gene names to the IDs
MouseAtlas <- readRDS("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds")
mouse_all_genes <- rownames(MouseAtlas)
rm(MouseAtlas)
gene_id_reference <- data.frame(ensembl_gene_id = gsub(pattern = "-.*", replacement = "", x = mouse_all_genes),
                                gene_name = sub(pattern = "^[^-]+-", replacement = '', x = mouse_all_genes))

## Processing age of transcriptome
age_est_noNaN <- age_est %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(Age_Adj) == FALSE)
age_NaN <- age_est %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(Age_Adj)) %>% pull(ensembl_gene_id)

## Processing pseudobulk to retain only PCGs
ref_pseudobulk[ref_pseudobulk < expr_cutoff] <- 0
rownames(ref_pseudobulk) <- gsub(pattern = "-.*", replacement = '', x = rownames(ref_pseudobulk))
to_remove <- rownames(ref_pseudobulk[rowSums(ref_pseudobulk) == 0,])
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk[!(rownames(ref_pseudobulk) %in% to_remove),]
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk[rownames(ref_pseudobulk) %in% pcg_list,]

## Merging
data <- ref_pseudobulk %>% 
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% age_est_noNaN$ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  left_join(age_est_noNaN) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(Age_Adj, everything())
age <- data$Age_Adj
top_drivers <- data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Age_Adj, SpT) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(per_gene_tai = Age_Adj*SpT) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(fraction_cont = per_gene_tai / sum(per_gene_tai)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(fraction_cont))
top_drivers$positively_selected <- rownames(top_drivers) %in% psl_list
top_drivers <- top_drivers %>% dplyr::mutate(positively_selected = case_when(positively_selected == "TRUE" ~ "Yes", .default = "No"))

## Sanity check - fraction contribution should add up to 1
sum <- sum(top_drivers$fraction_cont)
stopifnot(sum == 1)

## Subsetting
top_drivers <- top_drivers %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, fraction_cont, rank, positively_selected) %>%
  head(n=30) %>%
  left_join(gene_id_reference)

top_drivers <- top_drivers %>% dplyr::mutate(gene_family = case_when(gene_name %in% c("Tpbpa", "Cts3") ~ "Cathepsin",
                                   gene_name %in% c("Prl8a9", "Prl7a2", "Prl3b1", "Prl8a6", "Prl8a8", "Prl2b1", "Prl7d1") ~ "Prolactin",
                                   gene_name %in% c("Ceacam14", "Ceacam11", "Ceacam5", "Psg21", "Psg27", "Gm5155", "Ceacam12", "Ceacam13", "Psg18", "Psg16", "Psg28", "Psg17", "Psg23") ~ "CEA", .default = "Other"))
top_drivers$gene_family <- factor(top_drivers$gene_family, levels = c("CEA", "Prolactin", "Cathepsin", "Other"))
top_drivers$positively_selected <- factor(top_drivers$positively_selected, levels = c("Yes", "No"))

p1 <- ggplot(data = top_drivers, mapping = aes(x = reorder(gene_name, desc(fraction_cont)), y = fraction_cont, fill = gene_family, shape = positively_selected)) + 
  geom_point(size = 10) + 
   theme(panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 19, angle = 37.5, hjust = 1, colour = "black"), 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, colour = "black"),
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20)) + 
  ylab("Contribution to the transcriptome phylogenetic age") + 
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Family", values = c("Cathepsin" = "#C982B8", "Prolactin" = "#08418F", "CEA" = "#E69500", "Other" = "grey60")) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Positive selection signature", values = c("Yes" = 23, "No" = 21)) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 8)))
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/4d_Mouse_SpT_top30TAIContributors.png", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/4d_Mouse_SpT_top30TAIContributors.pdf", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Empty the environment
rm(list = ls())
```
